trigger.description: ee recall --diff <ref> or --diff-staged could not collect the changed-path set because the read-only git shell-out failed (git missing from PATH, not a git worktree, bad ref, or an option-shaped ref refused by the safety check). The diff selector degrades to an empty path set and recall continues with the remaining selectors — a recall failure must never block an edit (ADR 0064 §2).
setup_commands: # run from a workspace directory that is not a git worktree

message_contains: --diff selector degraded to an empty path set
